headline: Stricter Inheritance and Gift Tax Burden on Low-PBR Companies: Business Succession Deduction Limit Raised to 1 Trillion Won, but Parking Lots and Other Assets Excluded - Economy | Hankook Ilbo
summary: The 2026 tax reform plan raises the inheritance and gift tax burden on major shareholders of low-PBR listed companies. Business succession deduction requirements tighten, and the limit rises to 100 billion won.
why: Inheritance and gift taxes affect how controlling shareholders of listed Korean companies transfer stakes, which can influence share prices and governance. Price-to-book (PBR) ratios compare a stock's market value with its book value.
